title: Perfect halloween table decoration!.
text: Perfect halloween table decoration!.. The perfect addition to my slowly growing halloween decoration for my home <3 I really loved this lace it looks exactly as pictured. Although it was a little longer and bigger than I expected I just folded it in half and still looks great! I love it!

product_metadata.title: DII Black Lace Overlay Tabletop Collection Gothic Halloween Decor, Table Topper, 40" Round, Spider Web
features: FOR YOUR SPOOKY TABLE: This 100% polyester festive table topper measures 40" in diameter, appropriate for a table that can fit 4-6 people, ghouls, or goblins

ADD A CREEPY FINISHING TOUCH: This lace table topper is the perfect addition to decorate your tabletop for Halloween parties; The lace material adds a elegant and homely look to your table setting while providing haunting ambiance
ENHANCE YOUR HAUNTED HOUSE: Use our table topper to decorate for a dark and gloomy Halloween tabletop sure to delight, and terrify, both grown ups and trick or treaters
CARE INSTRUCTIONS: Machine wash cold on gentle cycle; Tumble dry low; Low iron if needed

MAKE IT A DII HALLOWEEN: In addition to looking great on its own, you can also pair this table topper with DII Halloween napkins, napkin rings, table runners, placemats, and more; search "DII Halloween" to explore the full collection
description: DII offers full collections of trend based designs, bringing you fresh, innovative lines of quality home products for every season. Let DII products become a valuable part of your life.

details.Product Care Instructions: Machine wash cold on gentle cycle. Use mild detergent. Wash dark colors separately. Do not bleach. Tumble dry on low setting. Press with warm iron as needed.
